experience.title: People Operations Lead
responsibilities: Own end-to-end employee journey from offer letter through exit interview for a 150-person org
Partner with legal counsel to keep personnel files audit-ready under current labor regulations
Run monthly compensation & benefits cycles, including variable pay components, alongside finance
Maintain time-and-attendance system and reconcile leave/overtime discrepancies each pay period
Own data integrity across the HRIS for headcount and compensation records
Drive talent acquisition strategy: define hiring plans, publish openings, and manage candidate pipeline
Design and deliver new-hire integration programs
Partner with department leads to build annual learning & development curriculum
Track L&D program outcomes and report on completion and impact
